content: Session 2026-08-09: Vector fully working (socket /run/vector/syslog.sock, vector-setup boot service, config after apk install, VRL ?? {} fix). Secure Boot CONFIRMED — harness 22/22 PASS incl secureboot_conf, uki_artifacts, clevis_bindings, tpm_auto_unlock. EFI keys fix validated. Per-subvolume btrfs compression via btrfs property set (zstd data, NoCoW swap). All packages single apk add. Less dummy package implemented (bat replaces less). internal_rules cleaned. session-memory skill fixed.
less package issue: solved via dummy package (bat replaces less). internal_rules dummyPackages section handles it. harness less_dummy check verifies symlink chain + bat version. IMPLEMENTED.

Per-subvolume btrfs compression: mount root WITHOUT compression, create subvols, then btrfs property set compression zstd on data subvols. NoCoW subvols get chattr +C, swapfile also chattr +m (NOCOMPRESS). fstab NoCoW entries carry compress=no.

Vector socket on /run/vector/syslog.sock (NOT /dev/log — vector user cannot create socket in /dev). vector-setup service (boot stage, after localmount) creates /run/vector, symlink /dev/log, chown vector:vector /var/log (no -R). Config written AFTER apk install. Check: apk info | grep -q '^vector$' (init-system agnostic).

EFI keys (efi-mkkeys -s 'FeralOS' -o /etc/uefi-keys) generated AFTER package install, matching reference chroot.sh flow. WriteSecurebootConf skips if /etc/uefi-keys/db.key missing. FIX VALIDATED — harness 22/22 PASS, secureboot_conf + uki_artifacts + clevis_bindings + tpm_auto_unlock all green.

internal_rules.yaml cleaned: defaultRunlevels only base OS services (sysinit/boot/default/shutdown). All package-triggered services in packageLogic (eudev udev trio, vector, earlyoom, cronie, chrony, dbus, openssh, smartmontools, acpid, irqbalance, fwupd, incus, qemu, zram, btrfs, cryptsetup). modules service removed (booster loads /etc/modules).

NO CI pipeline (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI). Testing via harness (QEMU automated) + debug-run (manual boot existing run). Phase 1 COMPLETE incl Nix integration. Next: Phase 2 (Dinit init system, custom FeralOS repo, full release).

Roadmap restructured: Phase 1 (Installer) — add btrfsRaid0 (2-disk RAID0, same as btrfsStandardServer). Phase 2 (Desktop) — niri + wayvnc only. Phase 3 (Distribution) — Dinit, custom repo, full release. Nix already done in Phase 1.
umount fix: check mountpoint -q before umount -fR to avoid warning when /mnt not mounted. Both btrfsStandard and btrfsStandardServer partitioning.go updated. Build verified OK.

New layout planned: btrfsStandardUnencrypted — single disk, Btrfs, no LUKS. For VMs where encryption adds unnecessary overhead. README, ROADMAP, AGENTS.md updated. TODO: implement in src/hostPhase/disks/.

README rewritten: memory-safe alternatives table (booster, grub→UKI), Dinit replacing OpenRC (with choice), semi-immutable approach (apk core + nix userland), Virtual Machines section (btrfsStandardUnencrypted), Enterprise merged into Virtualization Host (k3s + LINSTOR/Pirateus + ZFS).
